{{Short description|International football club competition in Europe}} {{EngvarB|date=June 2026}} {{Use dmy dates|date=June 2026}} The '''2026–27 UEFA Champions League league phase''' began on 8 September 2026 and will end on 27 January 2027. A total of 36 teams are competing in the league phase to decide the 24 places in the [[2026–27 UEFA Champions League knockout phase|knockout phase]] of the [[2026–27 UEFA Champions League]]. [[Real Betis]] made their first appearance in the Champions League since the [[2005–06 UEFA Champions League|2005–06]] season.{{cite news |date=12 May 2026 |title=Real Betis returns to Champions League after 20 years |url=https://apnews.com/article/real-betis-champions-league-atletico-la-liga-ca851fe5e0ecd9845aec052dcee2ad71 |access-date=2 June 2026 |publisher=[[Associated Press]]}} [[Como 1907|Como]], [[LASK]], [[Sabah FK (Azerbaijan)|Sabah]] and [[Viking FK|Viking]] made their debut appearances in the league phase/group stage.{{cite news |url=https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/02a8-2171a88881a0-c70193b972c6-1000--meet-the-2026-27-champions-league-league-phase-teams/ |title=Meet the 2026/27 Champions League league phase teams |publisher=UEFA |date=27 August 2026 |access-date=27 August 2026 }} For the first season since [[1999–2000 UEFA Champions League|1999–2000]], Norway has two clubs in the Champions League main stage.{{cite web |url=https://swedenherald.com/article/norway-to-have-two-teams-in-the-champions-league-for-first-time-in-27-years |title=Norway to Have Two Teams in the Champions League for First Time in 27 Years |publisher=Sweden Herald |date=26 August 2026 }} Additionally, two Turkish sides qualified for the main phase for the first time since the [[2007–08 UEFA Champions League|2007–08]] season.{{cite web |url=https://www.turkiyetoday.com/sports/turkiye-to-field-2-clubs-in-champions-league-for-6th-time-3226913 |title=Türkiye to field 2 clubs in Champions League for 6th time |publisher=Türkiye Today |date=27 August 2026 }} The Greek champions, [[AEK Athens F.C.|AEK Athens]], return to the UEFA Champions League after an eight-year absence.{{cite web|title=AEK Athens in the 2026/27 Champions League: What are their fixtures? Who is in their squad?|publisher=UEFA|date=2026-08-27|url=https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/02a9-2182e7bc0d8c-12e4d3e297a1-1000--aek-athens-in-the-2026-27-champions-league-what-are-their-/|access-date=2026-09-10}} A total of 16 national associations are being represented in the league phase. ==Format== Each team will play eight matches, four at home and four away, against eight different opponents, with all 36 teams ranked in a single league table. Teams were separated into four pots based on their [[UEFA coefficient#Men's club coefficient|2026 UEFA club coefficients]], and each team will play two teams from each of the four pots – one at home and one away. The top eight teams in the standings will receive a [[Bye (sports)|bye]] directly to the round of 16. The teams ranked from 9th to 24th will contest the knockout phase play-offs, with the teams ranked from 9th to 16th seeded for the draw while teams ranked 17th to 24th are not. Teams ranked from 25th to 36th will be eliminated from European competition. ===Tiebreakers=== Teams will be ranked according to [[Points (association football)|points]] (3 points for a win, 1 point for a draw, 0 points for a loss). If two or more teams are equal on points upon completion of the league phase, the following tiebreaking criteria are applied, in the order given, to determine their rankings:{{Cite web |date=1 March 2026 |title=Regulations of the UEFA Champions League 2026/27 Season |url=https://documents.uefa.com/r/Regulations-of-the-UEFA-Champions-League-2026/27-Online |access-date=2 June 2026 |publisher=[[UEFA]] |language=en |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260824122629/https://documents.uefa.com/r/Regulations-of-the-UEFA-Champions-League-2026/27-Online |archive-date=24 August 2026}} While the league phase was in progress, teams were ranked according to criteria 1–5 only, and if still tied, were given equal ranking and sorted alphabetically. Criteria 6–10 were only used after the final matches took place. #Goal difference; #Goals scored; #Away goals scored; #Wins; #Away wins; #Higher number of points obtained collectively by league phase opponents; #Superior collective goal difference of league phase opponents; #Higher number of goals scored collectively by league phase opponents; #Lower disciplinary points total (direct red card or expulsion for two yellow cards in one match = 3 points, yellow card = 1 point); #[[UEFA coefficient#Men's club coefficient|UEFA club coefficient]]. ==Teams and seeding== The 36 teams were divided into four pots of nine teams each, with the Champions League title holders automatically placed as the top seed of pot 1.
